newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Jilin Chemical Fibre sees 96 poor result.
newsitem.headline: Jilin Chemical Fibre sees 96 poor result.

text.p: China's Jilin Chemical Fibre Co Ltd failed to meet its 1996 net profit target of 79.18 million yuan due to weak demand for its products, a company source said on Wednesday.
But he declined to say what the profit figure was.

Prices of the company's products dropped 30 percent in 1996 from the 1995 level, costing the company about 190 million yuan, the company official told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
The firm expected business to pick up in 1997 in line with a recovery in China's chemical fibre market, he said.

The company, which listed 30.976 million A shares on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange last August, had forecast in its prospectus a net profit of 79.18 million yuan for 1996, compared with 89.31 million yuan in 1995.
Jilin Chemical's shares closed at 13.90 yuan on Wednesday, down 0.16 yuan.
